title: review-cost record
description: What the change cost before its review page existed, measured by /record-review in the harness that ran it: writing the code, the review (finding), and the auto-fixes (taking the review's advice, every CI round included). Written by record-review.py finish as review-cost.json beside review-points.md and committed with the [auto-fix] commit; read by review-cost.py --ledger for the $ tab's first three rows. Validated where it is written and where it is read (scripts/review_points_schema.py).

harness.description: The harness that ran /record-review: claude-code, copilot-cli or vscode-copilot (another name is kept, and its rows say they cannot be read).

rounds.description: Every finish, oldest first: the first is the review commit, the rest are CI-fix rounds. The auto-fix row runs to the last.

aicUsd.description: Dollars per Copilot AI credit used to state Copilot rows in $ (GitHub's billing rate).

reason.description: Why nothing was measured. Never null on an unmeasured row: $0.00 and 'nobody could see this' must not read alike.

usd.description: Claude: list-price equivalent. Null on a Copilot entry.

aic.description: Copilot: AI credits, its native unit. Null on a Claude entry.

subagentModels.description: The models of the agents the session forked inside the window, apart from its own — in the review row, the reviewers.

subagents.description: How many agents the session forked inside the window (harness_cost.claude_entry) — the review chip's '(4 subagents)'.

efforts.description: Claude only: model → reasoning effort → turns at it, read off each assistant record's `effort` (harness_cost.transcript_efforts). What the PR footer and the $ tab print as `Opus 5.5 (effort: high)`.

peakContext.description: Claude only: model → the largest context one turn carried. Past 200k it proves the 1M window (`context: 1M`).
